## `neuro.symbol.for`

Static method on `Symbol`.

> Returns a Symbol object from the global symbol registry matching the given key if found.
> Otherwise, returns a new symbol with this key.

## Signatures

```ts
for(input: { key: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<symbol>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Symbol.for` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
